issues.title: Malformed planner response causes AttributeError
issues.body:
**Describe the bug**
The planner uses json mode, output schema, prompts to produce structured output, while some models either produces plain contents regardless of the required schema or reply with additional marks such as ```. As a result, run response of agno agents will be a str object instead of BaseModel. Additional type check is recommended if we are using output schema in agno agents.

**Actual behavior**
AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute blahblah

issues.title: Planner calls the same tool again and again when using google/gemini-2.5-flash from OpenRouter
issues.body: **Describe the bug** Planner’s unreasonable tool-calling behavior **To Reproduce** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1.
